message.content: {"items":[{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2010 (EWCS 5)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11022","justification":"Large comparative survey with extensive occupational health, safety, and working conditions indicators for EU member states and associated countries, including the listed countries, conducted in 2010."},{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2015 (EWCS 6)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12563","justification":"Cross‑national survey covering work organization, physical and psychosocial risks, health outcomes, and work–life balance in the 2010s across nearly all listed European countries."},{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2012 – 2013 (EWCS 6 Pilot / Extended Module)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11852","justification":"Pilot/extended wave in the early 2010s with rich occupational health and safety content and coverage of many EU countries including those requested."},{"title":"European Social Survey 2010, Round 5","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11418","justification":"ESS Round 5 includes modules on work, family, and well‑being; several items capture aspects of occupational health and job conditions across many of the specified countries around 2010."},{"title":"European Social Survey 2012, Round 6","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11870","justification":"Provides cross‑national microdata on self‑reported health, work strain, and job characteristics in the 2010s for numerous European countries, supporting occupational health analyses."},{"title":"European Social Survey 2014, Round 7","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12253","justification":"Contains indicators of work autonomy, demands, and health that can be used to study occupational health patterns during the mid‑2010s in many of the listed countries."},{"title":"European Social Survey 2016, Round 8","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12942","justification":"Covers job quality, work pressure, and health status; suitable for occupational health research in European countries in the latter half of the 2010s."},{"title":"European Social Survey 2018, Round 9","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13325","justification":"Late‑2010s ESS wave with variables on work conditions, employment, and self‑reported health, allowing occupational health comparisons across many of the requested countries."},{"title":"European Company Survey 2013","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12191","justification":"Establishment‑level survey on workplace practices, health and safety measures, and working time in EU countries and some neighbors during the early 2010s."},{"title":"European Company Survey 2019","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13544","justification":"Firm‑level data on health and safety policies, employee representation, and working conditions at the end of the 2010s, covering many of the listed European countries."}]}
